sentences.text: This species is known from thoracic armor featuring a very flat dorsal side.
The species Silurolepis platydorsalis was formally described by Zhang and colleagues in 2010.
Silurolepis belongs to the class Placodermi, a group of armored fish.
A 2019 study reclassified Silurolepis as a maxillate placoderm closely related to Qilinyu.
Silurolepis lived during the Ludlow epoch of the Silurian period.
It lived between 426.7 and 425 million years ago during the Gorstian stage.
